description: This Java class 'LoanProductFloatingRates' defines the entity for representing floating interest rates associated with loan products, including various rate differentials and related relationships within a financial application.

classes.name: LoanProductFloatingRates
classes.description: Entity class representing floating rates associated with a loan product, including interest rate differentials and constraints.

methods.name: fetchInterestRates
methods.description: Fetches a collection of floating rate period data based on the current object and modifies the provided FloatingRateDTO with the interest rate differential.
